summary: Warner cosponsored the 2025 Antisemitism Awareness Act, directing the Education Department to use the IHRA definition for campus investigations. On Gaza, he co-sponsored a May 2025 resolution urging the U.S. to break Israel's blockade and co-authored a Senate Foreign Relations Committee statement on Israeli operations. In April 2026 he voted to advance a bulldozer ban for Israel but against blocking 1,000-pound bomb bodies, and his January 2025 ceasefire remarks used "both sides" framing.
